Erlc.intro: Connect your ER:LC (Emergency Response: Liberty County) private server with its server key. In-game 911 calls become CAD calls, and dispatch sees every player on Dispatch > ER:LC. Needs the ERLC API server pack.
Erlc.featureOffMessage: Turn on ER:LC in CAD Settings > Features first. Until then the CAD doesn't contact ER:LC.
Erlc.state_startingDetails: The CAD is about to check the server.
Erlc.state_featureOffDetails: Turn on ER:LC in CAD Settings > Features.
Erlc.state_disabledDetails: Turn on "Enable ER:LC" below and save.
Erlc.state_notConfiguredDetails: Paste your private server's key below and save.
Erlc.state_pausedDetails: ER:LC rejected the server key 3 times in a row, so the CAD stopped checking to avoid being blocked. Save a new key, or start checking again if the key is right.
Erlc.state_onlineDetails: The CAD is checking the server and creating calls.
Erlc.state_offlineDetails: The key works, but the private server is empty. The CAD checks once a minute until someone joins.
Erlc.state_rateLimitedDetails: ER:LC asked the CAD to slow down. It waits as long as ER:LC asks before checking again.
Erlc.state_errorDetails: The last check failed. See the error below; the CAD tries again on its own.
Erlc.enabledDescription: When off, the CAD doesn't contact ER:LC and the webhook answers 404.
Erlc.serverKeyIntro: In ER:LC, open your private server's Settings and search for "API key" (or go to erlc.link/sk). The key is never shown again after you save it.
Erlc.keySetPlaceholder: Leave empty to keep the saved key
Erlc.keySet: A key is saved. Type a new one to replace it.
Erlc.apiKeyDescription: Only for apps registered with PRC as a public application. A CAD for one server doesn't need it.
Erlc.pollSecondsDescription: 10 to 300. Each check is one request to ER:LC, however many dispatchers are online.
Erlc.saveFirstHint: Save your changes before you test the connection.
Erlc.test_rejectedDetails: ER:LC refused the key. Copy it again from the server's settings, and check the server has the ERLC API pack.
Erlc.test_offlineDetails: The key works, but the server is empty. Join the server and try again.
Erlc.test_moduleOutdatedDetails: ER:LC's in-game module is old. Kick everyone from the private server and try again.
Erlc.test_unreachableDetails: The CAD could not connect to api.erlc.gg: {message}
Erlc.create911CallsDescription: Turn off to only show the server on Dispatch > ER:LC.
Erlc.teamsIntro: Choose what each ER:LC team's 911 calls create in the CAD. A team that isn't listed creates a police 911 call.
Erlc.webhookIntro: ER:LC can send each 911 call to the CAD the moment it's made, instead of at the next check. Every request is signed by ER:LC and checked by the CAD.
Erlc.webhookNeedsHttps: ER:LC only accepts HTTPS addresses. Put the CAD's API behind HTTPS to use the webhook; the regular checks work without it.
Erlc.webhookStep1: Turn on ER:LC here and save, so the CAD answers ER:LC's check.
Erlc.webhookStep2: In ER:LC, open your private server's Settings, search for "Event Webhook" and paste the URL.
Erlc.pageIntro: Your ER:LC private server as the CAD last saw it. Updates every 10 seconds.
Erlc.commandError_notReady: ER:LC isn't set up or is paused.
Erlc.commandError_wait: ER:LC allows one command every 5 seconds. Try again in {seconds} s.
Erlc.commandError_offline: The server is empty, so ER:LC can't run commands.
Erlc.commandError_restricted: ER:LC doesn't allow this command from the API.
Erlc.noEmergencyCalls: No emergency calls in the server right now.
